evidencia.frag: Fellow Binancians, Binance has completed the Mainframe (MFT) token swap, redenomination and rebranding plan to Hifi Finance (HIFI)
For more information, please refer to the following: Binance Will Support the Mainframe (MFT) Token Swap, Redenomination & Rebranding Plan to Hifi Finance (HIFI)
